dst.faq_intro: Simple answers to help you choose and use your Dead Sea care with confidence.
dst.faq_1_q: Where do the minerals come from?
dst.faq_1_a: Our mineral-care story begins at the Dead Sea in Jordan, where the brand has been rooted since 1995.
dst.faq_2_q: How do I choose the right product?
dst.faq_2_a: Browse by face, body or hair, then review the product description and ingredients on its page before adding it to your routine.
dst.faq_3_q: How should I use a new skincare product?
dst.faq_3_a: Follow the directions on the product page or package. Patch-test first and stop use if irritation occurs.
dst.faq_4_a: The delivery estimate, available shipping methods and payment options for your address appear during Salla checkout.
